title: A power saving for planar halving lines
main_claim: Every even n-point planar set in general position has at most C n^{4/3-eps} halving lines (and uniformly over all ranks, S_k(P) <= C N^{4/3-eps}); proved via a nonquantitative uniform little-o improvement of the Dey/crossing-lemma activity-packing bound, obtained by contradiction from limiting rank-coordinate measures, followed by a fixed-scale recurrence.
coverage: Read all 8 sections in full. Finite part: re-derived the designated-endpoint crossing lemma (p=12v/e0, q=12m/e0 gives e0^3<=288mv cr, then 2304, and the localized 4608 a^2 m S^3), the convex/concave chain partitions (<=aS chains, <=2 crossings per chain pair), the activity->endpoint-distance lemma at ranks k+-floor(b/4) (persistence of pair comparisons; ceil(b/2)-c>=c), greedy batches, and the classical O((N/a)^{4/3}). Recurrence: blocks <= eta(2q)^{4/3}+1 <= q^{4/3}/2; sum t_j^beta <= (q^{4/3}/2)(N/q)^beta = N^beta/sqrt2; restricting to active points gives a fixed-rank sweep. Rank limits: rank-slot error 2/M, unique slot pairs because sorted graphs from disjoint windows have separated chord slopes, so the (z_I,z_J) projection of sigma_IJ is <= Lebesgue; variation <= 2M via concave chains; high-oscillation edges o(E_*) since (a/N)^{1/3}->0; edge/vertex mass lambda_J^3 <= C s_J^3 mu_J; nonatomic h_z (delta^{1/12} Holder step); lambda_K << sum sigma_IJ (delta^{1/9}, delta^{1/3} bookkeeping). Differentiability: monotone a.e. differentiability, critical-image null lemma (Vitali covering), independent gradients, disjoint allowed-direction sets D_p(t) with countably many non-singletons. Zoom: three-foliation compactness (cone parametrization, intersection convergence, seed v1/m scale argument even when b=0, inverse convergence via the Jordan curve theorem), bounded condition number of A_j, and the radial comparison with fixed h before late n. Spatial: Borel selection of T,m; anchoring gives U(p,h0)>=alpha and U(p,h1)<=2; iterated radii alpha^{j+1}, 2 beta^{j-1}; Hausdorff graph limit is single-valued; inverse Holder exponent 1+eta gives disk exponent 32/17 (bounded rank density after removing the singular part, which costs no edge mass by absolute continuity). Boundary: three-strips lemma checked line by line (thresholds, the 6rho gap, token conservation), token monotonicity in the dual-cone functionals gives <=4N boundary transfers, angular budget <=pi, and the final exponent (d-1)/3-1/4 = 5/17-1/4 = 3/68 > 0. I did not check the shallow-cutting corollary's citation details in depth. The compactness and diagonal quantifier ordering was checked by hand only, not by machine.
